landing.place: The Greywake lantern · late afternoon · nothing underway
landing.title: The lantern has been dark for four nights.
paragraphs: The lantern above Greywake has been dark for four nights. Your hands smell of oil from a failed repair. From the landing you can hear the harbor bell counting boats home.
A folded notice lies on the workbench, still sealed. The glass housing is open, and the damaged gear can be reached without taking it apart again.

notice.place: The Greywake lantern · late afternoon · notice in hand
notice.title: Under the harbor-watch seal.
paragraphs: The paper gives way at the crease. Under the harbor-watch seal, the message is short: Do not light the lantern until the evening patrol has inspected the passage.
No signature follows. A pencilled note at the bottom reads: Ask the watch why.
notice.status: You know what the notice says. The mechanism still waits.

choices.detail: Keep the lantern dark for now.

repair_accepted.title: Oil, teeth, and careful pressure.
paragraphs: You set the damaged gear and begin the slow work of seating it true. Oil darkens your cuffs. The harbor bell marks another boat.

visitor_work.title: Someone stops at the top of the stair.
paragraphs: Someone stops at the top of the stair. Water runs from the stranger's coat onto the stone. “Still dark,” they say, looking past you at the open lantern. “That may be for the best.”
They wear the dark band of the harbor watch. It could be genuine. Their hand stays carefully away from the workbench.
Your repair is held at three of nine work units. No reward yet — only interrupted progress this preview remembers.

ask_response.place: The Greywake lantern · after the question
ask_response.title: A claim, not a verdict.
paragraphs: “Because someone has been sailing without a light,” the visitor says. “That part sounds simple until you ask who needed the darkness.”
They glance at the folded notice. “Did you read that?”
ask_response.status: The visitor spoke. This preview can jump to a simulated return.

inspect_response.place: The Greywake lantern · after the inspection
inspect_response.title: The band could be genuine.
paragraphs: You study the dark band at their wrist. The weave matches harbor-watch work you have seen before, but wet cloth can lie.
They notice your attention and do not flinch. “Look as long as you like,” they say. “The lantern still needs answering.”
inspect_response.status: Inspection recorded for this preview. Jump when you are ready to return.

send_response.place: The Greywake lantern · after the dismissal
send_response.title: They do not leave at once.
paragraphs: You tell them to take the stair again. They hold your gaze a moment longer than courtesy requires.
“I will wait below,” they say at last. “Darkness has friends either way.”
send_response.status: The stranger stepped back. Jump when you are ready to return.

show_response.place: The Greywake lantern · after the order
show_response.title: They read without touching the seal.
paragraphs: You place the note between you. The visitor reads it once without touching the seal.
“Then you already know this came before I did,” they say. They step aside from the workbench, but they do not leave.
show_response.status: Their position changed because you knew the notice. Jump when you are ready to return.
